bio.text: According to her campaign website, Priscilla Ghaznavi, a candidate for New York's 7th Congressional District, was born in Washington, D.C., and has lived in New York for over three decades.
The site says she is a designer who has built a career across seven publicly traded companies in business and creative leadership.
It says she holds a bachelor's degree in marketing with a concentration in international trade and earned a degree in entrepreneurship in May 2026.
